title: Service Accounts and Repair Orders Payment Methods, Invoice Terms and Returned Payment Fee
content:
| Tier | Accepted payment methods | Payment due (calendar days after the line date) | Early-payment window (calendar days after the line date) | Early-payment discount (share of the invoice) | Returned payment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | cash, check, credit card, debit card | 0 | 0 | 0% | 30.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | cash, check, credit card, debit card | 0 | 0 | 0% | 30.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | cash, check, credit card, debit card | 0 | 0 | 0% | 30.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | cash, check, credit card, debit card | 0 | 0 | 0% | 30.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | check, ACH, credit card | 15 | 10 | 1% | 30.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | check, ACH, credit card | 30 | 10 | 2% | 30.00 |

Payment terms of **Service Accounts and Repair Orders** by tier. A due period of 0 means payment is due at pickup. The early-payment window and discount are figures of the fleet terms; on a tier where both read 0 no early-payment discount arises.
